### Changes implemented

- Upgraded `org.maplibre:mlt` from `0.0.4` to `0.0.6`.
- Added the transitive dependency `me.lemire.integercompression:JavaFastPFOR:0.2.1`.

- Removed the old general `mltAdvanced` config parameter and replaced it with granular FSST (`mltFsst`) and FastPFOR (`mltFastPfor`) options based on the upgraded MLT capabilities.

**`planetiler-core/src/main/java/com/onthegomap/planetiler/archive/TileArchiveWriter.java`**
- Refactored `ConversionConfig` creation in `TileArchiveWriter` to use the new Builder pattern introduced in `mlt` `0.0.6`:
  ```java
  var conversionConfig = ConversionConfig.builder()
    .includeIds(true)
    .useFastPFOR(config.mltFastPfor())
    .useFSST(config.mltFsst())
    .coercePropertyValues(true)
    .optimizations(optimizations)
    .preTessellatePolygons(false)
    .useMortonEncoding(true)
    .build();
  ```

**`planetiler-core/src/main/java/com/onthegomap/planetiler/util/TileSizeStats.java`**
- Replaced the deprecated class `MltTilesetMetadata` with `MltMetadata`.
- Refactored `computeMltTileStats` to match the new metadata structure using `StreamMetadataDecoder` and `IntWrapper`:
  ```java
  private static void skipOverStream(byte[] tile, IntWrapper offset) throws IOException {
    var streamMetadata = StreamMetadataDecoder.decode(tile, offset);
    offset.add(streamMetadata.byteLength());
  }
  ```
